children: Kanika Juneja has stepped down from her role as Category Marketing Head – Maggi at Nestlé, after nearly three years in the position.

Juneja has been with Nestlé for around six years. Before taking on the category leadership role for Maggi, she served as Marketing Manager for Maggi Flavor World and also held the position of Digital Head for Maggi.
Prior to joining Nestlé, Juneja was Senior Brand Manager – Horlicks at GSK Consumer Healthcare India.
She began her career with Dabur India and subsequently spent nearly three years with ITC.
With more than 14 years of experience across the FMCG sector, Juneja has worked across brand marketing, digital and category management roles spanning leading consumer businesses.
